# Content Strategy Template

## Business Goal

Increase brand awareness and generate leads.

## Target Audience

Describe your ideal customer.

## Content Pillars

- Educational
- Promotional
- Testimonials
- FAQs
- Behind the Scenes

## Channels

- Facebook
- Instagram
- LinkedIn
- YouTube
- Blog

## Posting Frequency

3–5 posts per week.

## Success Metrics

- Reach
- Engagement
- Website Traffic
- Leads
